gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.empty: Add a character in Crawl to start.

detail.tagsHint: what these {posts} are actually tagged with · share of posts

aside.title: Image detail
aside.gone: removed at source - kept here, never re-fetched

related.title: Related images
related.caption: Pages of the same {source} post, then images from the same {other} post ({id}). Click to switch; ← → steps through them.
related.captionPages: Pages of the same {source} post. Click to switch; ← → steps through them.

aside.keptNote: Kept the {kept} original; the {other} copy is recorded, not stored.
aside.revealHint: Show the file in Finder / Explorer

label.title: Label
label.pendingLine: 0 images not fully labeled yet | 1 image not fully labeled yet | {n} images not fully labeled yet
label.firstUse: the first run downloads the classifiers (up to ~1.3 GB)
label.unavailable: Labels are off: the optional classifier is not installed ({cmd})

menu.title: Delete images

image.title: By image
image.desc: Pick tiles in the grid. Click, shift-click for a range, or drag a box.

tag.title: By tag
tag.desc: Click a tag, character or artist chip to mark everything carrying it.

smart.title: Smart · AI identifier
smart.desc: Low recognition score, other characters, near-duplicates, photos. Pre-checked, you review before deleting.

all.title: All {n} images
all.desc: Empties the archive for {label}. The character and its crawl config stay. Typed confirmation.

menu.foot: Everything goes to trash first · {days} days

bar.leaveConfirm: Drop the selection and leave? Esc again

hint.image: Click a tile to mark it. {shift} marks a range, drag on empty space to box-select, {a} marks all visible, {esc} leaves.
hint.tag: Click a tag, character or artist chip to mark every image carrying it. Click a tile to drop one from the set.
hint.smart: Matches are pre-checked. Adjust the criteria on the left, then uncheck anything you want to keep before deleting.
hint.all: Every image is marked. Click a tile to keep it. The character and its crawl config stay.

tag.none: Click a chip above to mark every image carrying it.
tag.everything: This is everything. Use All instead?

smart.title: Criteria
smart.scoreNote: crawl cutoff is {n} - these got in before the cutoff was raised
smart.otherUnknown: No character named in this gallery yet - identify its images first
smart.dupesNote: keeps the larger file, selects the rest of each group
smart.kindsNote: what the recognition filter rejects at crawl time - cosplay, people, figures, renders, UI - that got in while it was off
smart.unidentifiedNote: no character found - many false positives
smart.applyNote: writes the criteria to Settings › Duplicates
smart.sorted: sorted by confidence · lowest score first
smart.off: Character names are off - switch them on in Settings › Characters

sheet.title: Delete 0 images | Delete 1 image | Delete {n} images
sheet.trashNote: restorable for {days} days · Settings › Storage · trash is {size} now
sheet.forget: Forget the 0 posts | Forget the post | Forget the {n} posts
sheet.forgetNote: marks them visited so the next {target}-post run won't bring them back
sheet.forgetNoteAll: leave off to let the next run rebuild with the current rules
sheet.warnShared: {n} of these are also in another character's gallery. Deleting removes them there too.
sheet.warnMany: More than 500 images or 1 GB: they go to trash, never straight to permanent.
sheet.allStrip: This empties the whole character. To also stop crawling {label}, use Delete character in the header's more menu instead.

toast.trashed: 0 images moved to trash | 1 image moved to trash | {n} images moved to trash
toast.deleted: 0 images deleted | 1 image deleted | {n} images deleted
toast.forgotten: 0 posts forgotten | 1 post forgotten | {n} posts forgotten

empty.title: No images
empty.sub: the character and its crawl settings stay - run it from Crawl to fill it again
